name: A city beyond the square
description: Twelve connected everyday destinations. Registration provides possibilities, not invented visits or relationships.

entities.name: Market Hall
entities.label: Market
entities.description: Covered produce stalls, an inexpensive lunch counter, and traders packing away at different times.
